description: This file implements the SystemInfo class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing system information retrieval, system time setting, environment variable management, and system reboot functionality. It includes platform-specific code for Linux, macOS, and Windows, and defines methods for constructing unique device IDs, hostname, and gathering system metrics like CPU load, memory, and architecture.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Provides system information such as hostname, CPU load, memory, architecture, and firmware version, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: Captures a snapshot of system memory info from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Id
methods.description: Generates a unique system ID based on device ID and system prefix.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateCpuStats
methods.description: Updates CPU load statistics based on platform-specific data sources.

methods.name: SystemInfo::UpdateRealtimeInfo
methods.description: Updates real-time system metrics such as memory and uptime.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system timezone environment variable.

methods.name: System::Reboot
methods.description: Performs a system reboot by invoking platform-specific commands.
